body.x: A comprehensive case-handling library. Each row is a scenario with step-by-step actions across four stages: Get Details, Verify / Check, Action / Submit, Notify / Close.
Applies to all Livechat case handling. Navigate by category. Always tag the chat correctly (see Tags & Categories) and close with an offer of further assistance plus a good-luck wish.

Format note: this SOP is a scenario library. Its four stage columns (Get Details, Verify / Check, Action / Submit, Notify / Close) are this library's form of the 4-element step: the Action is the stage entry, the Sequence is the left-to-right stage order, the Degree / standard is the check condition in each cell, and the Tool is the BO / Lark ticket named in the cell. The columns are kept as-is rather than split per scenario.

x: Always close with an offer of further assistance plus a good-luck wish.
Always tag the chat correctly (see Tags & Categories).
When escalating to WL, Support, IT or PYM, always include Username/UID, amount and screenshots.
After submitting any ticket, tick the Claimed checkbox in the relevant tracker.
Run a fresh identity verification every chat; never rely on a previous one.
